# XO Spark

> Free, fast, responsive Tic-Tac-Toe (X and O) game for laptop and mobile, with smart computer opponent and a daily Thirukkural verse.

## Pages

- [XO Spark — Play Tic-Tac-Toe](https://xo-spark.vercel.app/): The main game with 2-Player and vs Computer modes, neon themes, and a random Thirukkural after every round.

## Features

- Local 2-Player and vs Computer modes (Easy, Medium, Hard).
- Random starting player each round.
- Sound effects with on/off toggle.
- Move counter and best-win streak tracking.
- Sixteen themes including Arcade Rush, Christmas, Diwali, Holi, Navratri, Pongal, and Halloween.
- Responsive layout for laptop, tablet, and mobile.
- Thirukkural verses from Thiruvalluvar, with Tamil original and English translation by Rev. G. U. Pope (public domain).

## Notes

- No login or sign-up required.
- No tracking or cookies.
- Published as a static site on Vercel.
